author: Astra/root
scope: Independent offline data-contract cases, prepared before reading the producer implementation. Synthetic fixtures do not qualify publisher access, real field meaning or research fitness.

cases.purpose: Identical literal wire names in separately valid source/asset/release/distribution/schema/field-revision contexts have distinct IDs, including Unicode and punctuation that must not be normalized together.
Missing essential context remains explicitly unresolved with null identity and reason; completeness of unrelated labels or dictionary counts cannot resolve it.

A context assembled from independently valid but unrelated source, asset, release, distribution, snapshot or field identities cannot become resolved. Positive consistent controls accompany each mismatch.

Existing snapshot/field immutability and old join endpoint shape remain intact. Failed variable registration must not leave a usable false resolved binding. Returned values cannot mutate registered identity through shared references.

A documented identifier permits an explicit reasoned not-applicable unit. A measurement lacking a unit remains incomplete. An empty reason or unreviewed assertion cannot disguise missing measurement semantics.

Publisher label, concept and definition retain separate literal fields. Census concept-only text leaves definition null; CDC names retain their exact spelling and documented type never masquerades as observed type.

Leading-zero code 001, sentinel -999, Unicode text, literal slash and tilde keys survive without numerical coercion or pointer corruption. Claimed raw-value hashes and pointers match actual retained capture bytes.

Changed capture bytes, a foreign capture URL/context, a mismatched raw value or unknown transformation cannot establish verified extraction provenance. Available APIs either reject or keep the evidence explicitly unverified.

The old cdc_columns and census_variables transformations and existing claim verification return byte-identical output on independently chosen fixtures before and after PR008. Frozen schemas, routes and CMS parser bytes stay unchanged.
An existing CMS parser result is an input to the additive adapter. A dictionary-only name stays a documented name until a supported wire mapping exists. Parser input is not mutated.

Exact, reviewed alias, ambiguous and unmatched states have coherent names, evidence and alternatives. Equal field counts, case folding, punctuation replacement and Unicode dash substitution alone cannot approve aliases.

Both 117-field audit counts and all eleven supplied HCRIS identifier differences remain represented as the retained discrepancy summary. No fabricated full inventory, automatic resolved mapping or new payload qualification is inferred.
